# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `meta-ads` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.facebook.com/ads`.
- OAuth sign-in through Facebook Login for Business using Cursor's Meta app ID as a pre-registered client, because Meta's authorization server does not accept dynamic client registration from Cursor.
- Logo: Meta's mark in Meta blue, on a white tile.
